item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa -- The Food Bank of Iowa is getting help from an Iowa-based grocery chain to help feed hungry people across the state. item.title: Mayors around the Metro: Russ Trimble, West Des Moines
item.description: WHO 13 NEWS -- Russ Trimble is three months into his second term as mayor of West Des Moines. He joined Calyn Thompson on the Digital Desk to speak about his priorities, the city's growth, and the future of Valley West Mall.
